methodology.UserFees: All swap, outbound and affiliate fees paid by users when swapping through THORChain (slashing is paid by nodes, not users).
methodology.Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools, gross outbound fees and slashing fees paid into the Reserve, and affiliate fees charged by interfaces/wallets (affiliate fees are attributed to the THORChain native chain). RUNE block-reward emissions and the native tx fee (counted in the THORChain chain fees adapter) are excluded.
methodology.Revenue: The share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before) - value to all RUNE holders - plus protocol-kept income (outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees, developer fund, marketing fund and the 20% directed into protocol-owned liquidity). The node-bonder share of swap fees is treated as a security cost and the LP, affiliate and TCY shares as supplier payments, so none of those count as revenue.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Income kept by the protocol: outbound fees net of the gas reimbursed to nodes, slashing fees paid into the Reserve, plus the 5% developer fund, 5% marketing fund and 20% protocol-owned liquidity taken from swap fees.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value to RUNE holders: the share of swap fees burned as RUNE (1% since 2026-09-12, 5% before), permanently removed from supply - the only component that accrues to every RUNE holder.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value paid to suppliers: the node-operator (RUNE bonder) share of swap fees set by the Incentive Pendulum (a security cost), the liquidity-provider share of swap fees (LP side of the Incentive Pendulum), affiliate fees passed through to integrators, the 10% of swap fees paid to TCY stakers, and the outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to nodes.

Fees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
Fees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Fees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

UserFees.Swap Fees: Slip-based liquidity (swap) fees paid by users on each chain's THORChain pools.
UserFees.Outbound Fees: Gross outbound fees charged to users and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
UserFees.Affiliate Fees: Fees charged by the interface or wallet that built the swap (attributed to the THORChain native chain).

Revenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).
Revenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
Revenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
Revenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
Revenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

ProtocolRevenue.Outbound Fees: Outbound fees kept by the protocol: gross outbound fees charged to users minus the gas reimbursed to nodes, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Slashing Fees: Fees slashed from misbehaving nodes and paid into the Reserve, a network-level figure split across chains by each chain's share of daily swap volume.
ProtocolRevenue.Developer Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the developer fund (since 2024-09-16).
ProtocolRevenue.Marketing Fund: 5% of swap fees allocated to the marketing fund (since 2025-11-04).
ProtocolRevenue.Protocol Owned Liquidity: 20% of swap fees the Reserve directs into protocol-owned liquidity (since 2026-09-01).

HoldersRevenue.RUNE Burn: Share of swap fees burned, permanently removing RUNE from supply and accruing value to RUNE holders (5% from 2024-09-16, 1% from 2026-09-12).

SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To RUNE Bonders: Node operators' (RUNE bonders') share of swap fees, set network-wide by the Incentive Pendulum - a security cost paid to the nodes that bond RUNE to secure the network.
SupplySideRevenue.Swap Fees To LPs: Liquidity providers' share of swap fees (the LP side of the Incentive Pendulum).
SupplySideRevenue.Affiliate Fees To Integrators: Affiliate fees passed through to the integrator that built the swap.
SupplySideRevenue.TCY Staker Rewards: 10% of swap fees paid in RUNE to TCY stakers (since 2025-05-01).
SupplySideRevenue.Gas Reimbursement: Outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to the nodes that broadcast outbound transactions, paid out of the gross outbound fee.

methodology.Fees: Native and ZRO fees paid by users for cross-chain messages routed through the LayerZero V1 endpoint, summed from WithdrawNative and WithdrawZRO events on UltraLightNodeV2 contracts across supported chains. Withdrawals lag the actual send() events by the worker/treasury withdrawal cadence; totals converge over time.
methodology.Revenue: ZRO protocol fees moved from UltraLightNodeV2 to the LayerZero V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO. Historically the V1 protocol take rate has been ~0, so this value is typically negligible. Tokens flow to the Foundation treasury and are not burnt by the contract.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: ZRO protocol fees collected by the LayerZero V1 Treasury contract.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Native fees paid out to V1 relayers and oracles via WithdrawNative. Includes a small protocol-native portion when treasury chooses native payment, but in practice the protocol take is ~0 so this is effectively all worker revenue.

Fees.Protocol Fees: ZRO protocol fees withdrawn from UltraLightNodeV2 by the V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO.

Revenue.Protocol Fees: ZRO protocol fees moved to the V1 Treasury contract.

SupplySideRevenue.Service Fees: Native fees paid out to relayers and oracles.

methodology.Volume: Settled trade volume. A trade with a Bitcoin leg is counted through its other leg.
